description: HP-29 is the Regional Transport Office code for the Jogindernagar sub-division in the Mandi district of Himachal Pradesh. It functions as a Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) under the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM), providing essential services such as vehicle registration and driving license issuance.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Jogindernagar, District Mandi, Himachal Pradesh
